credits: Sophos builds on Prime Intellect's open-source Prime Agent (PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent, MIT). OpenRO, OpenBell, Fleet and Ergon ship as cross-platform single-binary Rust desktop and web apps (Linux, macOS, Windows) on one shared House Frontend design system.
intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship single-binary Rust desktop and web applications (Linux, macOS, and Windows .exe with chromeless desktop launch) are OpenRO v1.1.0 (Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with Agent/Plan/Ask unified Luau diffs, Monetization & Retention Luau pack with ProcessReceipt idempotency, directly embedded live Roblox Studio + auto-synced Explorer, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, Market Taste Craft Radar, Blender/WAV tools, and Rojo .zip export), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v0.9.0 (Codex/Linear parallel coding-agent workbench with Goal-to-DAG planner, -24.1% bundle, interactive multi-wave Board / DAG Graph toggle, confirmation-gated PR Preview, Worktree Inspector, Daily Dispatch Budget guardrails, and Auto-Heal), alongside Ergon v0.10.0 (Claude-Desktop employee agent desk with unified responsive SPA -47.8% vs v0.9.0, inline approval/diff cards, background cadence scheduler, .history/ file version diff & restore, tamper-evident Field-Book audit bundles, 3-company switcher, and 12 workflows).
